title: Inter-agent handoff contract
description: One handoff payload transferring control, context, and responsibility from one agent to another. A contract, not a note: typed fields only, versioned, validated at generation time with repair-on-failure. Free-text narrative payloads are forbidden by design.

taskId.description: Stable identifier for the unit of work being handed off. Constant across every handoff for the same task.

intent.description: The receiving agent's next required action as a discrete, enumerable directive — not prose.

state.description: Structured current state: the typed fields the receiving agent needs to act, not a transcript. Target 200-500 tokens, never full-context forwarding.

summary.description: Bounded structured summary of progress (fielded, not narrative). Keep terse.

artifacts.description: Lightweight references to externally persisted work products, not inlined content.

decisions.description: Explicit decisions already made, so downstream agents do not silently re-decide them.

confidence.description: Self-reported confidence in the handed-off state. Low values must be surfaced before the handoff proceeds.

provenance.description: Cross-boundary trace context so the full execution graph can be reconstructed.

traceId.description: Correlation ID constant across the entire multi-agent execution graph.

spanId.description: Span ID for this handoff, child of the producing agent's span.

sourceAgent.description: Identifier/role of the agent ceding ownership in this handoff.

parentSpanId.description: Optional parent span ID preserving the parent-child nesting across agent transitions.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this contract. Breaking field changes require a major bump; receivers reject incompatible majors.

autonomyLevel.description: Optional governance level for the receiving action, calibrated to reversibility: 1 human-approves (irreversible) ... 4 full autonomy (reversible low-stakes).
